leaves.doc:
A concept class is a set of concepts. Used by every paradigm, complexity
measure, and criterion.

Primary definition: Set of functions. Used for PAC/agnostic PAC where
concept classes are sets over which VC dimension, Rademacher complexity,
covering numbers, etc. are measured. Alternative definitions below for
contexts requiring decidability, enumerability, or measurability.
leaves.pretty: Type u → Type v → Type (max v u)

leaves.doc:
A concept is a function from domain to label. This is the atomic unit that
concept classes collect and learners try to approximate.
leaves.pretty: Type u → Type v → Type (max u v)

leaves.doc: A complete binary Littlestone tree of depth n.

Path-wise shattering for complete trees.
Path B: leaf case requires C.Nonempty (NA₁₀).
leaves.pretty: {X : Type} → {n : ℕ} → ConceptClass X Bool → LTree X n → Prop

leaves.doc: Truncate a complete tree to a smaller depth.
leaves.pretty: {X : Type} → {n m : ℕ} → n ≤ m → LTree X m → LTree X n

leaves.doc:
Littlestone dimension: the maximum depth of a complete shattered tree.
Path B: returns WithBot (WithTop ℕ) so Ldim(∅) = ⊥ (NA₁₀).
leaves.pretty: (X : Type) → ConceptClass X Bool → WithBot (WithTop ℕ)

leaves.doc:
Mistake-bounded learning: the learner makes at most M mistakes on ANY sequence.
No distribution assumption. Characterized by Littlestone dimension.
leaves.pretty: (X : Type u) → (Y : Type v) → [DecidableEq Y] → ConceptClass X Y → ℕ → Prop

leaves.pretty: (X : Type u) → (Y : Type v) → [DecidableEq Y] → ConceptClass X Y → Prop

nodes.doc:
The optimal mistake bound equals the Littlestone dimension (for nonempty C).
Path B: OptimalMistakeBound : WithTop ℕ, LittlestoneDim : WithBot (WithTop ℕ).
For nonempty C, LittlestoneDim ≥ 0, so the coercion ↑(OptimalMistakeBound) works.
nodes.pretty: ∀ (X : Type) (C : ConceptClass X Bool), Set.Nonempty C → ↑(OptimalMistakeBound X C) = LittlestoneDim X C
∀ (X : Type) (C : ConceptClass X Bool), LittlestoneDim X C < ⊤ → OnlineLearnable X Bool C

nodes.doc:
SOA mistakes from a given state are bounded by the Ldim of the version space.
This is the core M-Potential argument.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool},
  ∀ c ∈ C,
    ∀ (history : List (X × Bool)),
      (∀ p ∈ history, c p.1 = p.2) →
        ∀ (d : ℕ),
          LittlestoneDim X (versionSpace C history) ≤ ↑↑d →
            LittlestoneDim X (versionSpace C history) < ⊤ → ∀ (seq : List X), (SOA X C).mistakesFrom history c seq ≤ d

nodes.doc: Extending history restricts the version space.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {history : List (X × Bool)} {x : X} {y : Bool},
  versionSpace C (history ++ [(x, y)]) ⊆ versionSpace C history

∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {c : X → Bool},
  c ∈ C → ∀ {history : List (X × Bool)}, (∀ p ∈ history, c p.1 = p.2) → c ∈ versionSpace C history

nodes.doc: On an SOA mistake, the Ldim of the version space strictly decreases.

hypotheses.name: hpred
hypotheses.pretty: (SOA X C).predict history x ≠ c x

nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {history : List (X × Bool)} {x : X} {c : X → Bool},
  c ∈ versionSpace C history →
    (SOA X C).predict history x ≠ c x →
      LittlestoneDim X (versionSpace C history) < ⊤ →
        LittlestoneDim X (versionSpace C (history ++ [(x, c x)])) < LittlestoneDim X (versionSpace C history)

nodes.doc: SOA predicts the label whose side has higher Ldim.

When Ldim(V) = 0 (↑↑0), all concepts in V agree on every point.
Key lemma for M-VersionSpaceCollapse.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {V : ConceptClass X Bool},
  LittlestoneDim X V = ↑0 → Set.Nonempty V → ∀ (x : X) (c₁ c₂ : X → Bool), c₁ ∈ V → c₂ ∈ V → c₁ x = c₂ x

nodes.doc:
Build a tree of depth k+1 from shattered subtrees on both sides.
Parametrized over b : Bool so we don't need to case-split in the caller.

hypotheses.name: hb
hypotheses.pretty: ∃ Tb, LTree.isShattered {c | c ∈ V ∧ c x = b} Tb

hypotheses.name: hnb
hypotheses.pretty: ∃ Tnb, LTree.isShattered {c | c ∈ V ∧ c x = !b} Tnb

nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {V : ConceptClass X Bool} {x : X} {k : ℕ} {b : Bool},
  (∃ Tb, LTree.isShattered {c | c ∈ V ∧ c x = b} Tb) →
    (∃ Tnb, LTree.isShattered {c | c ∈ V ∧ c x = !b} Tnb) →
      (∃ c ∈ V, c x = b) → (∃ c ∈ V, c x = !b) → LittlestoneDim X V ≥ ↑↑(k + 1)

nodes.doc: From Ldim ≥ d, extract a shattered tree of depth exactly d.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {d : ℕ}, LittlestoneDim X C ≥ ↑↑d → ∃ T, LTree.isShattered C T

nodes.doc: A truncated tree is shattered if the original is.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {m : ℕ} (T : LTree X m),
  LTree.isShattered C T → ∀ {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m), LTree.isShattered C (LTree.truncate h T)

nodes.doc: In `WithBot (WithTop ℕ)`, `a < ↑↑(n+1) → a ≤ ↑↑n`. Reusable lattice fact.
SOA mistakesFrom cons: unfold one step using the interface.
nodes.pretty:
∀ (X : Type) (C : ConceptClass X Bool) (history : List (X × Bool)) (c : X → Bool) (x : X) (xs : List X),
  (SOA X C).mistakesFrom history c (x :: xs) =
    (if (SOA X C).predict history x ≠ c x then 1 else 0) + (SOA X C).mistakesFrom (history ++ [(x, c x)]) c xs

nodes.doc: Shattering is upward-monotone in the concept class.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {n : ℕ} (T : LTree X n) {C C' : ConceptClass X Bool},
  C ⊆ C' → LTree.isShattered C T → LTree.isShattered C' T

nodes.doc:
Adversary lower bound (M-InfSup reusable primitive):
If a tree of depth n is shattered by C, then any mistake-bounded learner
must allow at least n mistakes. This is the "inf ≥ sup" half of minimax.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {n : ℕ} (T : LTree X n),
  LTree.isShattered C T → ∀ {M : ℕ}, MistakeBounded X Bool C M → n ≤ M

nodes.doc: Relate mistakesFrom to the original mistakes function.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {X : Type} (L : OnlineLearner X Bool) (c : X → Bool) (seq : List X), L.mistakesFrom L.init c seq = L.mistakes c seq

∀ {X : Type} (L : OnlineLearner X Bool) (s : L.State) {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {n : ℕ} (T : LTree X n),
  LTree.isShattered C T → Set.Nonempty C → ∃ seq, ∃ c ∈ C, L.mistakesFrom s c seq = n

nodes.doc: Helper: shattering implies the concept class is nonempty.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {X : Type} {C : ConceptClass X Bool} {n : ℕ} (T : LTree X n), LTree.isShattered C T → Set.Nonempty C

nodes.doc: SOA init state is empty history.
nodes.pretty: ∀ (X : Type) (C : ConceptClass X Bool), (SOA X C).init = []
